algorithm: SHA-256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON (sorted object keys, compact separators, arrays preserved) over only the selected semantic key

semantic_keys.Entity: record subtype plus declared stable identity fields
semantic_keys.Activity: stage, type, stable instance key, occurrence index, operation type
semantic_keys.Usage: Activity ID, used Entity ID, base role, deterministic ordinal
semantic_keys.Generation: generated Entity ID and Activity ID
semantic_keys.Derivation: generated Entity ID, used Entity ID, Activity ID, Generation ID, Usage ID, base role, ordinal
semantic_keys.Association: Activity ID, Agent ID, role, ordinal

invariants: Same selected semantics produce the same ID.
Profile-external Core changes do not change an ID.
Selected semantic changes change an ID or normalized record.
No randomness, wall time, memory address, local path, or execution order is used.
A deterministic ordinal distinguishes legal repeated relations.
Statement ordering does not affect canonical records.
PROV-N and PROV-O normalize to these same identifiers and records.
